title: ICP → TAM Mapper input (icp.json)
description: Authored by the research step. Two blocks: `matrix` drives the XLSX, `airk` drives the AI Ark TAM/SAM/SOM funnel.

key_signal_name.description: Short label for the Key Qualifying Signal (used as a column header + scoring category).

key_signal.description: One sentence naming the Key Qualifying Signal AI Ark can't filter (goes in the Clay section of the breakdown).

clay_signals.description: Extra bullets for the 'what AI Ark can't filter' section.

matrix.description:
Standard ICP Matrix format. Every cell is rich prose with SOURCE: citations. Bullets use 
, paragraphs 

.

account_level.description: 8 rows: LOCATION, EMPLOYEE COUNT, INDUSTRY, BUSINESS MODEL (KEY SIGNAL), TECH STACK, REVENUE, FUNDING/OWNERSHIP, INTENT.

prospect_level.description: 4 rows: SENIORITY, DEPARTMENT/JOB TITLE, LINKEDIN PROFILE KEYWORDS, LINKEDIN ACTIVITY SIGNALS.

signal_scoring.description: 100-point model. Category rows carry max_points on their top tier; use {"category":"SEPARATOR"} rows between categories. Sum of max_points must equal 100.

airk.description: AI Ark filter spec. Drives TAM (all geos/broad industry) → SAM (priority geos + core gate) → SOM (sweet-spot size).

icp_type.description: firmographic = clean industry defines it. signal_defined = no clean industry, defined by what they do (keyword only). hybrid = industry base + keyword gate (e.g. executive search inside Staffing & Recruiting).

geographies.description: Full country names — all target geos (TAM).

industries.description: AI Ark industry strings — broad set (TAM).

keyword_terms.description: The 'what they do' gate (hybrid/signal_defined). Lowercase short phrases.

revenue_floor.description: USD floor applied to SOM, or null.

personas.description: Buyer personas counted within the SAM base.

titles.description: Plain title strings, no bare 'Founder' (that's a seniority).
